scope: Study 1 automatic A-D experiment in the structured travel-editing prototype

design.modelIdentityPolicy: fit and report each frozen model identity separately; pooled estimates are exploratory only

primaryEndpoint.successDefinition: every round satisfies its immediate goal, tested active goals and active constraints; no retired goal leaks; no semantic or technical failure; and no unauthorized changed path
primaryEndpoint.failurePolicy: timeouts, invalid output, guard rejection, state rejection, version conflict and other registered technical failures remain failures

multiplicity.family: the three D-versus-A/B/C contrasts at length 20, separately within each model identity

confirmatory.replicationRule: Do not pool the two model identities for a confirmatory claim. Report both adjusted contrast families; call an effect replicated only when both point estimates have the same direction and both Holm-adjusted tests meet alpha. Otherwise report heterogeneity or non-replication.

model.formulaR: success ~ method * interaction_length + execution_position + (1 | template_id) + (1 | block_id)
effectMeasures: conditional odds ratio with Wald 95% CI
model-adjusted probability difference with Wald 95% CI

sensitivityAnalyses: replace the six-level template random intercept with template fixed effects while retaining the block random intercept
task-template paired exact sign-flip tests and task-template bootstrap intervals
report the method-by-length likelihood-ratio test without treating it as a substitute primary endpoint
fit a pooled model-identity interaction only as an exploratory heterogeneity analysis

required: maximum absolute scaled gradient when available
outcome counts by model, method and length
all denominators and registered technical-failure counts
diagnostics.failureRule: If the primary model does not converge or is non-estimable, retain the data and report the diagnostic failure. Do not simplify the endpoint, delete failures or promote a sensitivity analysis after seeing results.

missingData.episodeOutcome: must be present; missing required human labels block dataset assembly rather than being imputed
missingData.technicalFailure: coded as primary-endpoint failure, not missing
missingData.providerWideInterruption: handled only by the preregistered whole-block rerun rule before analysis
missingData.exclusions: none beyond invalid provenance or a preregistered provider-wide interrupted block

secondaryEndpoints.analysis: template-grouped estimates and sensitivity mixed model; goal-update episodes are structurally ineligible and excluded from this endpoint only
raw numerator/denominator and task-template robust intervals; structural zeros or separation are reported rather than concealed

runtime.lockRequirement: record R and package versions and run the synthetic contract test before changing status to frozen-tested
